description: Change several Tasks in one call, such as completing two and starting the next, or setting the estimates of several, instead of one call each. The operations are applied in order, so a start can follow the complete of the Task that was in progress; if any one fails, none is applied. A 'state' operation takes the same helper_branch, helper_folder, helper_label (with 'with a helper') and evidence (with 'checked') as set_task_state. Each operation can name its own claimed Goal with goal, else the call's goal (or the only Goal held) is used. The recommended way to change more than one Task. Answers with one line per call, not the whole status.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

action.description: start: mark in progress. complete: mark done. state: set the state given in state. drop: drop it, with reason. estimate: only set its estimate.

code.description: For action 'complete': files the Task touched, optionally with :line.

estimate.description: The Task's new estimate, such as '45m' or '2h' (any action; needed for 'estimate'); an empty string removes it.

evidence.description: With state 'checked': one short line on what you checked, such as '715 passed, live send OK'. Give it: the Developer sees it on the dashboard step.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

helper_branch.description: With state 'with a helper': the git branch the helper works on, such as 'feat/export'. Recorded so a branch left behind can be found later.

helper_folder.description: With state 'with a helper': the helper's worktree folder (its path).

helper_label.description: With state 'with a helper': a label for the helper, such as the model it runs on ('Sonnet').

reason.description: For action 'drop': why the Task is no longer needed.

state.description: For action 'state': the new state, as in set_task_state.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the fix or change the Task makes, such as 'Callback re-sets the session cookie on every hit; only set it after token exchange.'

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

name: update_tasks
title: Update Tasks
